Daytime Patrol Marks the area of daytime patrolling. Position patrol banners near production sites where prisoners work to prevent their escape, as well as places where lumberjacks and herbalists work to protect them from fleshwolf attacks. Guards from among your warriors will automatically go on patrol during daytime.

Wise Conversation A conversation takes place during which the character shares knowledge, provided the interlocutor has a sufficient Intelligence skill level. Required Intelligence skill level: $ Basic knowledge (gray): level {var_1} $ Advanced knowledge (green): level {var_2} $ Superior knowledge (purple): level {var_3} One random piece of knowledge is shared at a time, from simpler to more complex. Additionally: $ A character with the "Enlightener" trait can share any knowledge with anyone without restrictions, but their conversation partner may convert to their culture. $ If the character is elderly, they will share two pieces of knowledge at once. Hint: You can invite friendly characters from other cities (or abduct them) to gain valuable knowledge — for example, knowledge from other cultures.
